title: Wisdom of God
definition: The wisdom of God means that God perfectly knows and chooses the best purposes and means according to His holy will.
summary: God's wisdom is perfect, trustworthy, and beyond human measure.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the wisdom of God, and through Him God's saving plan is revealed.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God's wisdom means He never acts foolishly, shortsightedly, or carelessly. He knows all things perfectly and orders His purposes according to what is best and holy.

Human beings often cannot trace God's wisdom in suffering, waiting, or unexpected circumstances. But Scripture teaches that God's ways are higher than ours.

The cross displays God's wisdom in a way the world considered foolish. Through Christ crucified, God saves sinners and reveals wisdom beyond human pride.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often judge God's wisdom by whether life makes sense to them. The wisdom of God matters because it teaches believers to trust Him when they cannot understand His ways.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask God for wisdom, but also submit to His wisdom. When His path is difficult, remember that the cross once looked like defeat but became salvation.
